task: Identify and list the specifications of the latest iPad model released by Apple, including its storage options, processor type, and display features.
answer:
FINAL: As of October 27, 2026, the latest iPad released for sale is the iPad Air (M4), in 11-inch and 13-inch sizes, available since March 11, 2026. Apple’s newer iPad mini (A20 Pro) was announced October 26, but becomes available November 6, 2026. [Air release](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/03/apple-introduces-the-new-ipad-air-powered-by-m4/) · [Mini announcement](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/10/apple-gives-ipad-mini-its-biggest-update-ever/)

The released iPad Air (M4) specifications are:

- Storage, both sizes: 128GB, 256GB, 512GB, or 1TB.
- Processor: Apple M4 with an 8-core CPU (3 performance and 5 efficiency cores), 9-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, and 12GB unified memory.
- Display, both sizes: Liquid Retina LED-backlit Multi-Touch with IPS technology, P3 wide color, True Tone, fully laminated construction, antireflective and fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coatings, and Apple Pencil hover support.
- 11-inch display: 2360 × 1640 pixels at 264 ppi; 500 nits brightness. Rectangular diagonal: 10.86 inches.
- 13-inch display: 2732 × 2048 pixels at 264 ppi; 600 nits brightness. Rectangular diagonal: 12.9 inches.

[Apple’s iPad Air technical specifications](https://www.apple.com/ipad-air/specs/)

For the newest announced model, iPad mini (A20 Pro):

- Storage: 128GB, 256GB, or 512GB.
- Processor: A20 Pro; 5-core CPU on 128GB/256GB models, 6-core CPU on 512GB; 7-core GPU throughout.
- Display: 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR OLED, 2316 × 1512 pixels at 326 ppi, P3 wide color, True Tone, fully laminated and antireflective. Brightness: 600 nits full screen, 1200 nits peak HDR, 1 nit minimum; 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio. Optional nano-texture glass on 256GB/512GB models.

Apple’s [iPad mini technical specifications](https://www.apple.com/ipad-mini/specs/), under Display, explicitly state “1 nit minimum brightness” and “2,000,000:1 contrast ratio.”

Evidence: Apple’s [iPad archive, newest entries](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/archive/ipad/) and [earlier entries](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/archive/ipad/?page=2) establish the release chronology. The screenshot final.png shows Apple’s [comparison page](https://www.apple.com/ipad/compare/?modelList=ipad-air-13-m4,ipad-air-11-m4,ipad-mini-a20pro), with the selected model names, capacity, display, and chip specifications visible together.
